display.purpose: Compact field-guide headings, brand, and high-level navigation.

body.purpose: High-legibility UI, controls, evidence, and tabular decision data.

shadows.name: docket
shadows.purpose: Separate the harvest docket from the map plate.

motion.name: page-pass
motion.purpose: One field-guide page transition; removed under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Field Olive action with Outfit semibold label and 44px minimum target.

components.name: Evidence Entry
components.description: Ruled warm entry connecting an outlet to its map marker and evidence.

components.name: Cartographic Desk
components.description: Full-width map plate with an overlaid harvest docket and synchronized ruled evidence ledger.

narrative.overview: AniWhere treats Laguna geography as the farmer's working decision surface. Ruled evidence and field-guide indexing keep uncertainty legible without turning the product into a decorative vintage artifact.

rules.name: Map Is the Workspace
rules.body: On discovery, the map receives the full available width and remains synchronized with outlet evidence.

rules.name: Evidence Before Confidence
rules.body: Unknown price, capacity, freshness, or route information stays visibly unknown.

dos: Do preserve substantial map area on mobile.
Do use Outfit for headings and Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for UI.
donts: Don't reduce discovery to a generic card dashboard.
Don't imply guaranteed demand, capacity, profit, or live routing.
